summary: Cook Islands’ supplied pledges are conservation-focused and contain no numerical restoration or agricultural-area commitment. The main ecosystem measure is the designation of the entire Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), reported as almost 2,000,000 sq km, as a marine park to strengthen marine-ecosystem resilience. This is a marine commitment and is not directly comparable with the country’s 240 sq km of land, which includes 111 sq km of forest (46.2%) and 89 sq km of agriculture (37.1%). A second conservation-related pledge commits the country to delivering 100% of its adaptation measures, providing tools and technologies, and strengthening capacity across all inhabited islands, conditional on external support. No timeframe is specified for either numerical commitment.
